vsm1.3:112.1: Yadi evaṃ yā asubhajjhānānaṃ appamāṇārammaṇatā vuttā, sā virujjhatīti.
vsm1.3:112.3: Ekacco hi uddhumātake vā aṭṭhike vā mahante nimittaṃ gaṇhāti. Ekacco appake.
vsm1.3:112.4: Iminā pariyāyena ekaccassa parittārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ hoti. Ekaccassa appamāṇārammaṇanti.
vsm1.3:112.5: Yo vā etaṃ vaḍḍhane ādīnavaṃ apassanto vaḍḍheti. Taṃ sandhāya ‘‘appamāṇārammaṇa’’nti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.3:113.1: Yathā ca etāni, evaṃ sesānipi na vaḍḍhetabbāni.
vsm1.3:113.6: Iti sādīnavattā okāsena ca paricchinnattā na vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:114.1: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ ‘‘mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā’’ti (dī. ni. 1.556) ādi,
vsm1.3:114.3: Ekāvāsadviāvāsādinā hi anukkamena ekissā disāya satte pariggahetvā bhāvento
vsm1.3:115.3: Tato paraṃ vaḍḍhayatopi na kiñci hoti.
vsm1.3:117.3: dasakasiṇā, dasaasubhā, ānāpānassati, kāyagatāsatīti imāni dvāvīsatipaṭibhāganimittārammaṇāni.
vsm1.3:117.5: Tathā dasasu anussatīsu ṭhapetvā ānāpānassatiñca kāyagatāsatiñca avasesā aṭṭha anussatiyo,
vsm1.3:117.16: yañca ālokakasiṇe sūriyādīnaṃ obhāsamaṇḍalārammaṇanti imāni aṭṭha calitārammaṇāni, tāni ca kho pubbabhāge, paṭibhāgaṃ pana sannisinnameva hoti.
vsm1.3:118.2: ettha ca dasa asubhā, kāyagatāsati, āhāre paṭikūlasaññāti
vsm1.3:118.4: Tāni dvādasa, ānāpānassati cāti imāni terasa brahmaloke nappavattanti.
vsm1.3:118.5: Arūpabhave pana ṭhapetvā cattāro āruppe aññaṃ nappavattati.
vsm1.3:119.2: Tatra ṭhapetvā vāyokasiṇaṃ sesā nava kasiṇā, dasa asubhāti
vsm1.3:119.4: Pubbabhāge cakkhunā oloketvā nimittaṃ nesaṃ gahetabbanti attho.
vsm1.3:119.11: Upekkhābrahmavihāro, cattāro āruppāti imāni cettha na ādikammikena gahetabbāni.
vsm1.3:120.1: Paccayatoti imesu pana kammaṭṭhānesu ṭhapetvā ākāsakasiṇaṃ sesā nava kasiṇā āruppānaṃ paccayā honti,
vsm1.3:121.3: rāgacaritassa tāva ettha dasa asubhā, kāyagatāsatīti ekādasa kammaṭṭhānāni anukūlāni.
vsm1.3:121.4: Dosacaritassa cattāro brahmavihārā, cattāri vaṇṇakasiṇānīti aṭṭha.
vsm1.3:121.5: Mohacaritassa, vitakkacaritassa ca ekaṃ ānāpānassati kammaṭṭhānameva.
vsm1.3:121.9: Sesakasiṇāni, cattāro ca āruppā sabbacaritānaṃ anukūlāni.
vsm1.3:121.10: Kasiṇesu ca yaṃkiñci parittaṃ vitakkacaritassa, appamāṇaṃ mohacaritassāti.
vsm1.3:122.1: Sabbañcetaṃ ujuvipaccanīkavasena ca atisappāyavasena ca vuttaṃ.
vsm1.3:122.2: Rāgādīnaṃ pana avikkhambhikā saddhādīnaṃ vā anupakārā kusalabhāvanā nāma natthi.
vsm1.3:122.9: Rāhulasuttepi ‘‘mettaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehī’’tiādinā (ma. ni. 2.120) nayena
vsm1.3:122.11: Tasmā vacanamatte abhinivesaṃ akatvā sabbattha adhippāyo pariyesitabboti
vsm1.3:122.12: ayaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvāti ettha kammaṭṭhānakathā vinicchayo.
vsm1.3:123.2: ‘‘Tena yoginā kammaṭṭhānadāyakaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ upasaṅkamitvā’’ti ettha vuttanayeneva vuttappakāraṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ upasaṅkamitvā
vsm1.3:123.3: buddhassa vā bhagavato ācariyassa vā attānaṃ niyyātetvā
vsm1.3:123.4: sampannajjhāsayena sampannādhimuttinā ca hutvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ yācitabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:124.1: Tatra ‘‘imāhaṃ bhagavā attabhāvaṃ tumhākaṃ pariccajāmī’’ti evaṃ buddhassa bhagavato attā niyyātetabbo.
vsm1.3:124.8: Niyyātitattabhāvassa panassa bheravārammaṇe āpāthamāgatepi bhayaṃ na uppajjati.
vsm1.3:124.9: ‘‘Nanu tayā, paṇḍita, purimameva attā buddhānaṃ niyyātito’’ti paccavekkhato panassa somanassameva uppajjati.
vsm1.3:125.1: Yathā hi purisassa uttamaṃ kāsikavatthaṃ bhaveyya, tassa tasmiṃ mūsikāya vā kīṭehi vā khādite uppajjeyya domanassaṃ.
vsm1.3:125.2: Sace pana taṃ acīvarakassa bhikkhuno dadeyya,
vsm1.3:125.3: athassa taṃ tena bhikkhunā khaṇḍākhaṇḍaṃ kariyamānaṃ disvāpi somanassameva uppajjeyya.
vsm1.3:126.1: Ācariyassa niyyātentenāpi ‘‘imāhaṃ, bhante, attabhāvaṃ tumhākaṃ pariccajāmī’’ti vattabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:126.2: Evaṃ aniyyātitattabhāvo hi atajjanīyo vā hoti,
vsm1.3:126.4: yenakāmaṃgamo vā ācariyaṃ anāpucchāva yatthicchati, tattha gantā,
vsm1.3:126.5: tamenaṃ ācariyo āmisena vā dhammena vā na saṅgaṇhāti,
vsm1.3:126.9: nacirasseva dussīlyaṃ vā gihibhāvaṃ vā pāpuṇāti.
vsm1.3:127.1: Therassa kira santikaṃ tayo bhikkhū āgamaṃsu.
vsm1.3:127.3: ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, tumhākamatthāyā’’ti vutte sataporise papāte patituṃ ussaheyyanti āha.
vsm1.3:127.5: ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, tumhākamatthāyā’’ti vutte imaṃ attabhāvaṃ paṇhito paṭṭhāya pāsāṇapiṭṭhe ghaṃsento niravasesaṃ khepetuṃ ussaheyyanti āha.
vsm1.3:127.6: Tatiyo ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, tumhākamatthāyā’’ti vutte assāsapassāse uparundhitvā kālakiriyaṃ kātuṃ ussaheyyanti āha.
vsm1.3:127.8: Te tassa ovāde ṭhatvā tayopi arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsūti ayamānisaṃso attaniyyātane.
vsm1.3:127.9: Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘buddhassa vā bhagavato ācariyassa vā attānaṃ niyyātetvā’’ti.
vsm1.3:128.1: Sampannajjhāsayena sampannādhimuttinā ca hutvāti ettha pana
vsm1.3:128.2: tena yoginā alobhādīnaṃ vasena chahākārehi sampannajjhāsayena bhavitabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:128.3: Evaṃ sampannajjhāsayo hi tissannaṃ bodhīnaṃ aññataraṃ pāpuṇāti.
vsm1.3:128.13: sabbe te imeheva chahākārehi attanā attanā pattabbaṃ visesaṃ pattā.
vsm1.3:129.3: nibbānādhimuttena nibbānagarukena nibbānapabbhārena ca bhavitabbanti attho.
vsm1.3:130.2: cetopariyañāṇalābhinā ācariyena cittācāraṃ oloketvā cariyā jānitabbā.
vsm1.3:130.5: Ke vā te dhammā bahulaṃ samudācaranti?
vsm1.3:130.6: Kiṃ vā te manasikaroto phāsu hoti?
vsm1.3:130.7: Katarasmiṃ vā te kammaṭṭhāne cittaṃ namatīti evamādīhi nayehi pucchitvā jānitabbā.
vsm1.3:130.10: Pakatiyā uggahitakammaṭṭhānassa ekaṃ dve nisajjāni sajjhāyaṃ kāretvā dātabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:131.13: Evaṃ kathiyamāne pana kammaṭṭhāne tena yoginā nimittaṃ gahetvā sotabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:132.6: idamopammanti evaṃ taṃ taṃ ākāraṃ upanibandhitvāti attho.
vsm1.3:132.7: Evaṃ nimittaṃ gahetvā sakkaccaṃ suṇantena hi kammaṭṭhānaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti.
vsm1.3:132.8: Athassa taṃ nissāya visesādhigamo sampajjati, na itarassāti
vsm1.3:133.3: attano cariyānukūlaṃ cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesu aññataraṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvāti
vsm1.3:133.5:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Samādhibhāvanādhikāre
Kammaṭṭhānaggahaṇaniddeso nāma
Tatiyo paricchedo.
